title: Pearlmoor Quay - The Tide-blessing (Festival of the Floating Lights)
_note: The Tide-blessing festival cue (Arc E, the COOL mirror of Tinderwick's warm fair). SNES-register enrichment of the Pearlmoor anchor per the score bible §3.3: the Option-A 'Moonlit Quay Waltz' lead + waltz bass kept NOTE-FOR-NOTE (the town's identity and the Vesper-motif waltz), quickened 100->112 for festival energy; the band opened within <=7 peak voices — strings DYADS (root+fifth, oct 3, low gain bed), the bell-buoy chime line re-voiced pulse12->pluck (harp, same notes), and a sparse BELL voice that is the festival's signature: the MOOR-BELL tolls low (F4) at each section start and answers phrase ends with cool Light sparkle over the water. Moon-on-water, open, communal, a little melancholy. 24-bar 3/4 loop ~38s. Render --engine chip (house cohesion).

tracks.name: pad
tracks._note: Real harmony the chip could only imply: one root+fifth DYAD per bar (never triads — keeps peak voices at 7), following the waltz changes. A bed, not a wall.

tracks.name: moorbell
tracks._note: The festival's signature: the MOOR-BELL tolls low (F4, dotted-half) at each 8-bar section start, and cool Light sparkle answers phrase ends out over the water. Sparse — the quiet between tolls is the moon-on-water.
